title: He and His vessels are one: the vessel comes first, and its limit is only His choice
overview:
The class first finishes the last chapter's point on names: when you know the particulars, the outer name reaches the essence at once, with no effort. *Hisbonenus* means understanding, not meditation.

Chapter 29 then says that the vessels are one with Him as the lights are, and more: the vessel comes before the light. The empty balloon comes before the air, the popsicle mold before the water: the final physical world was the first thing in the thought. The power to limit is not a real limit. Like the hand's power of movement, it is spiritual, part of the essence, and limits only by will and choice: whoever gives $50 could have given $100. That power comes from the same place as the light. In the Infinite the power to spread and the power to stop are equal, and if anything the vessel, the crown, is higher. Even the vessels of *Atzilus* are only a power to limit; the limit in act begins below, and the deed stays joined to the one who did it, as the blow is the man's own. Last, *chesed* and *gevura* turn over: above, the light is kindness; for us the *tzimtzum* is.

sections.title: The vessel comes before the light
sections.summary: The class first finishes the last tape's point: knowing the particulars lets an outer name lead straight to the essence, with no effort. Then chapter 29 opens: the vessel comes before the light, as the empty balloon comes before the air, because the final physical world was the first thing in the thought.

phrases.he: (כט) אך גם הנה, בהתבוננות באורות וכלים דאצילות דרך פרט יותר, אין כללות ועיקר המכוון בהם רק בענין זה דאיהו וחיוהי חד וגרמוהי חד, שבאמת אין הפרש בין איהו וחיוהי חד לאיהו וגרמוהי חד דגם שהאורות הן בלי מה והכלים הן בבחינת יש כו',
מכל מקום מצד עצמות המאציל הרי עשה שורש להתהוות הכלים קודם שעשה שורש להתהוות האורות
phrases.en: What he's saying here basically is that the *kli* really comes before the light.

phrases.he: דמה שמהתעבות האור נעשה כלי, הרי קדם לזה עצמו שרש ומקור והוא שנקרא חומר הפשוט או חומר ההיולי שקודם לצורה כו'

blocks.text:
The tape opens in the middle of the last class's point on names. The cat's external name is the physical cat with all it does; inside is an internal name, in its DNA and animal soul. Seeing it, the word "cat" comes into my head from its external name, like the letters of *Asiya*, the *kelim* (vessels) that hold the soul; in my head it is already thought, speech and action, not the cat.

So a king's name in the far reaches of his kingdom is connected through a *hishtalshelus* (chain of descent) to his vision of himself as a great king, to an ambition in the *machshava kduma* (primordial thought), up to *Ana Emloch* (I shall rule) in the *Atzmus* (G-d's essence).
blocks.outOfPlace: The tape opens by finishing class 042's discussion of the inner and outer names (chapter 28); placed at the head of chapter 29, whose first line is about contemplation of the lights and vessels.

blocks.text: That is the basic thing: the three levels, *mocha*, *liba* and *kavda*, the upper's outer name becoming the lower's name, and even the lower outer name *mechavein* (aimed) at the higher.
blocks.outOfPlace: The end of chapter 28's discussion, at the start of the tape.

blocks.title: A friend we all know, and Marvin Finkelstein
blocks.text: So the *kavanos* (intentions) reach the inner names automatically. Saying the name of a friend everyone here knows took no effort: no forty years in a cave, no kvetching the face, not even *hisbonenus* (contemplation), because we know him. Say "Marvin Finkelstein" and you'll ask who he is: is he going to cheat you, or come up with a million dollars? It's just a name, connected to nothing, because you don't know the *seder hishtalshelus*; like telling someone who never heard of a mouse that there's one in the house.
blocks.outOfPlace: The end of chapter 28's discussion, at the start of the tape.

blocks.text:
*Hisbonenus* doesn't mean meditation; it means understanding, finding out the particulars. Knowing our friend's particulars, we are automatically *mechavein* to his essence. That is *daas* (knowledge), which, as chapter one says, is not concentration but *hiskashrus* (connection), feeling the concept with your mind.

So here: knowing the *hishtalshelus*, the minute you say the external name you are *mechavein* to the *Atzmus*, with no effort, an immediate connection of *daas elyon* (higher knowledge).
blocks.outOfPlace: The end of chapter 28's discussion; it leads into chapter 29, which opens with hisbonenus in the lights and vessels.

blocks.text: Chapter 29 is read through to the *chomer hapashut* (simple matter) or *chomer hiyuli* (formless matter) before the form: **the *kli* really comes before the light**.

blocks.title: The empty balloon
blocks.text: A balloon gets its shape from the air, like a Mickey Mouse balloon. But the empty balloon, a floppy piece of rubber, a *chomer* (matter) more *megusham* (coarse) than air, came first and had to stop the air, or there would be no *his'havus* (coming into being) of air; so the balloon buildings with air blowing in all the time.

So the final world, the empty balloon with no soul, preceded the line of light blown into it; the *tzimtzum* (contraction) has no dimensions, like the balloon unblown. A Jew's body came up in thought before his soul, or this world would not be needed: the world was *davka* (precisely) for the body. And for all *tefillin* do in *Atzilus*, first came the physical leather.
As explained in places, the *kli*, the final physical world, is not part of the *hishtalshelus*, a chain of lights from *yesh me'ayin* (something from nothing): it is directly from the *Atzmus*.

blocks.question: But there are *kelim* in the chain too; we keep talking about lights and vessels.
blocks.text: The Rebbe says those vessels come from the *his'havus* of the light: the *kelim* of *Atzilus* are lights made into *kelim*, which become the next level's light. But no light could come to be without a *kli* preceding it all, where you knew what you wanted.

blocks.title: The popsicle mold
blocks.text: A popsicle comes from freezing water, but without a mold to hold the water while it thickens, you couldn't make it.
The *kli* before the light is that the end physical world was really first, and that holds it all together. Even the *kelim* of *Atzilus* are preceded by the thought of the final thing.

sections.title: Two kinds of limit: the power to limit and the limit in act
sections.summary: A limit in potential, like the hand's power of movement, is spiritual, part of the essence, and no real limit: it limits by will and choice, as whoever gives $50 could give $100. A limit in act, the movement made, is physical, separate from the essence, and a real limit.

phrases.he: וביאור הדברים ידוע ומובן מהקדמה הידוע בענין כלים המגבילים ממש, שיש ב' מיני גבול הא' כח המגביל בעצם כמו כלי המוח המגביל והעין המגביל וכהאי גוונא אבל הוא רק בכח ולא בפועל עדיין
כמו שיש בכח ביד להגביל כל תנועה בגשם, קודם שיגביל בפועל ממש התנועה
phrases.en: The hand has this power of *hagbala* before it actually makes any particular *tnua*.

phrases.he: ואף על פי שגבול זה שבפועל ובגלוי הוא ממש כמו אופן אותו הכח המגביל הרוחני שביד,
phrases.en: In other words, it's according to what the power is, like the power of the eye can have sight and the power of the hand can have movement.

phrases.he: שהוא מקור ושרש להגבלה זו שבפועל, מכל מקום נבדל ערך הגבול בכח מגבול בפועל
phrases.en: It's a whole different type of *gvul*.

blocks.text: There are two kinds of *gvul* (limit). One is the power to limit in the essence, as in the brain or eye, only in potential: the hand can limit before any *tnua* (movement). The limit in act follows the power, **like the power of the eye can have sight**, yet it is **a whole different type of *gvul***.

phrases.he: הא' שזה רוחני ועצמי
phrases.en: The *koach hatnua* is really a *ruchni*; it's not an actual *tnua*. And it's an *etzmi*, it's part of the *etzem*.

phrases.he: וזה גשמי ונבדל מן העצם
phrases.en: And the actual *gvul* of an actual *tnua* is *nivdal min ha'etzem*, and it's physical.

blocks.text: First: the *koach hatnua* (power of movement) is *ruchni* (spiritual) and *etzmi*, part of the *etzem* (essence); an actual movement's limit is physical, *nivdal min ha'etzem* (separate from the essence).

phrases.he: והב' שהגבול בכח אינו גבול ממש
phrases.en: It's not a matter of an actual *gvul*.

phrases.he: רק שמגביל בכחו על פי רצון ובחירה לזה,
phrases.en: It means that he has a *ratzon* and a *bechira* to make a *hagbala*.

phrases.he: ואינו גבול מוכרח,
phrases.en: It doesn't mean that he has to do this particular *gvul*.

phrases.he: לומר שאין לו כח התפשטות עוד
phrases.en: Meaning that he couldn't put out more.

phrases.he: רק שאינו רוצה להתפשט יותר כו'
והרי זה רק עושה את ההגבלות, ואינו הגבלה אמיתית כגבול בפועל,
phrases.en: And this is just that the *koach hagvul* makes the *hagbala*, and it's not an actual *gvul*.

phrases.he: שהוא הגבלה אמיתית כו'
phrases.en: That's a real *hagbala*.

phrases.he: (וכמו שכתוב במקום אחר בענין פנימית הכלים וחיצוניות הכלים, שיתבאר בעזרת השם)
phrases.en: And this explains about the *pnimiyus* and *chitzoniyus* of the *kelim*.

blocks.text: Second: in potential **it's not a matter of an actual *gvul***, just the opposite: he has a *ratzon* (will) and a *bechira* (choice) to limit. It is not forced; he could put out more.

blocks.title: Fifty dollars, not a hundred
blocks.text: Wanting to give $50 doesn't mean he can't give $100. One who only has $50 has an actual *gvul*; in the *Aibershter* (G-d) it is not. So the *koach hatnua* need make no movement, or this one rather than another.
So **the *koach hagvul* makes the *hagbala*, and it's not an actual *gvul***, as the limit in act is. This explains the *pnimiyus* and *chitzoniyus*, inner and outer, of the *kelim*.

sections.title: Above: the power to limit comes from where the light comes from
sections.summary: The power that makes the vessels comes from the Essence, the same place the light comes from. The *kav hamida* carries both powers by His choice, and above it, in the Infinite, the power to limit and the power to spread are equal: He is *kol yachol*, able to spread out without end and able to stop.

phrases.he: וכך יובן למעלה בשרש ומקור כלים המגבילים לאור
דהיינו בשרש ומקור כח המגביל שלהם, שבא ונמשך מן העצמות,
phrases.en: Meaning the actual *koach* to make the *kelim* in the first place comes from the *Atzmus*.

phrases.he: שמשם נמשך התהוות האור עצמו
phrases.en: The same place where the light comes from, that's also where the power of the *gvul* comes from.

phrases.he: כמו מקור התהוות אור הרצון מהעלם עצם המקור לכל רצון הרי משם גם כן נמשך כח הגבול להגביל כח התפשטות אור הרצון, שלא יתפשט עוד כדי שיוכל להיות טעם לרצון שאם לא היה פוסק כח ואור הרצון, לא היה בא לעולם לכלל טעם לרצון

blocks.text: So above: the power to make the *kelim* comes from the *Atzmus*: **the same place where the light comes from, that's also where the power of the *gvul* comes from**. Lines 19 to 22 are read without comment.

phrases.he: והוא ממאמר קו המדה, העושה כל גבול בפועל ממש באורות
phrases.en: Like we explained before, the *kav hamida* had the power of all *gvul*.

phrases.he: וכך הוא עושה כל גבול בפועל ממש
בכלים דעשר ספירות המגבילים, איך שיגבילו בפועל ממש
אבל מקור ושרש שלהם אינו בחינת גבול אמיתי,
phrases.en: It's not a real *gvul*, that they're actually *mugbal*.

phrases.he: רק שהוא עושה את אופן ההגבלה
phrases.en: In other words, that's the *ratzon* of the *Aibershter* that does it.

blocks.text: The *kav hamida* (line of measure) makes every actual limit in the lights and *kelim*: **the *kav hamida* had the power of all *gvul***, both powers, from the *tzimtzum* and the light before it. But really the *kli* comes first.

blocks.title: The vacuum cleaner
blocks.text: Plugging into the wall, you didn't just want power to come out: you wanted the vacuum cleaner to clean the floor. You want the *kelim*; the light only enlivens them.
But their root is **not a real *gvul***, as if actually *mugbal* (limited): **that's the *ratzon* of the *Aibershter* that does it**, His *koach habechira* (power of choice), doing both.

phrases.he: (שזהו בא מקו המדה,
phrases.en: And the *kav hamida* really comes from higher.

phrases.he: מבחינת גבורה דאור אין סוף בחינת כח המכווץ שדומה לכח המתפשט,
וב' קוין שקולין הן כו'
phrases.en: And they're both equal.

phrases.he: כי כל יכול יש בו כח המגביל גם כן כו' (וכמו שכתוב במקום אחר)
phrases.en: It's the same *inyan* of *kol yachol*: He can spread out infinite, and He can stop it.

blocks.text: **The *kav hamida* really comes from higher**, from the *gevura* of the *Or Ein Sof* (infinite light), the limiting power that *docheh* (pushes away) the spreading one. The printed *domeh* (resembles) was mis-corrected; the original is *docheh*. One could say *domeh* too, he grants, since both are infinite.

**They're both equal**: the power of *hispashtus* (spreading) is the power of *kibbutz* (gathering), *chesed* and *gevura* of the *Ein Sof*, the *kol yachol* (the All-Capable): **He can spread out infinite, and He can stop it**.

phrases.he: ומבואר למעלה שזהו בחינת הרשימו כו',
phrases.en: This *reshimu* is the *koach hamegbil*.

phrases.he: שמשם הוא שרש הגבלת הכלים דעשר ספירות דאצילות ומבחינת הקו שנמשך מהרשימו, הוא שרש כל האורות כו' וכמו שכתוב במקום אחר באריכות)

blocks.text: **This *reshimu* is the *koach hamegbil***, and the *Or Ein Sof* the spreading *chesed*; the line combines both, as "and the awesome" was *tiferes* (beauty). Drawn from the *reshimu*, it is root of all the lights and all the limits of the *kelim*.

sections.title: Even the vessels of Atzilus are only a power to limit, and the outer name reaches the source
sections.summary: The vessels seem disconnected from the source, a something, but the same *Aibershter* makes them as makes the lights, and they are the very thing He wants. Compared to our world even the vessels of *Atzilus* are only the power to limit; the limit in act is in *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya*. So intent on the outer names reaches their source automatically.

phrases.he: ואם כן גם שבחינת הכלים דאצילות מגבילים ממש בבחינת שמות דע''ב ס''ג הנקרא אותיות, הרי אין זה רק מצד כח העושה לגבול זה בעצמות המאציל
והיינו דאיהו וגרמוהי חד, מכח דאין סוף עצמו, כמו דאיהו וחיוהי חד בבחינת האורות כו'
phrases.en: Really, it is the same power.

blocks.text: *Ihu v'garmohi chad*, He and His organs are one, as *ihu v'chayohi chad* in the lights: **really, it is the same power**. The lights seem directly connected, *bli ma*; the *kelim* are *davka* disconnected, a *metzius* (existence). Yet the same *Aibershter* makes both, and the lowest *kelim* are what He wants.

phrases.he: (ובאמת גם בחינת הכלים דעשר ספירות דאצילות הן כח הגבול, ולא גבול בפועל
רק כאשר האור ושפע נגבל מאין ליש בבי''ע, אז נקרא גבול בפועל ממש וכמו שיתבאר בעזרת השם)

blocks.question: If even the *kelim* of *Atzilus* are only a power to limit, why did he call them a *gvul b'poel* (limit in act) before?
blocks.text: It depends compared to what. Compared to the *Atzmus*, in the general worlds, *Atzilus* is *Asiya*. For our world, *Atzilus* is still the *etzem hasechel*, the essence of intellect, not *bina* or thought, speech and action: a power to limit.

Only the *shefa* (flow) limited from nothing to something in *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya* is an actual limit, in the particular worlds. In the general worlds *Atzilus* is *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya*, hence "limit in act"; there even *Adam Kadmon* is a *gvul*.

phrases.he: ולפי זה, המכוין בשמות דע''ב ס''ג שהן בבחינת הכלים המגבילים ממש כו',
הרי זה עצמו הכוונה במקור השמות דע''ב ס''ג כו',
שמהם נמשך מקור האור דאצילות
phrases.en: The names of *Ayin Beis* and *SaG* of *Adam Kadmon*, from which these *kelim* actually precede the light of *Atzilus*.

phrases.he: (uוהוא שם העצם, שהוא מורה על עצם המקור כנזכר לעיל)
phrases.en: That shows on the *etzem* of the thing.

phrases.he: והיינו ממקור התהוות הכלים, דאיהו וגרמוהי חד כנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: It's from the actual *makor*; it really shows on the *makor* of *his'havus hakelim*.

blocks.text: The intent in *Ayin Beis* and *SaG*, the limiting *kelim*, is their source, as we intend not these letters but the idea of the *Shaar HaYichud* upstairs: **the names of *Ayin Beis* and *SaG* of *Adam Kadmon***, which precede the light of *Atzilus*.
The *shem ha'etzem*, a proper noun, **shows on the *etzem* of the thing**: our friend's name on him, "a cat" on a cat.
**It really shows on the *makor* of *his'havus hakelim***: *ihu v'garmohi chad*. Intending the outer name, you intend the inner.

sections.title: One with the tikunim: the deed stays joined to the power that limited it
sections.summary: Even the outer *tikunim*, down to the vessels of *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya*, are one with Him, because a limit in act is united with the power that limited it, as the blow is the man's own. The vessels' root in the Essence equals the lights' root; if anything the vessels are higher, as a crown.

phrases.he: וממילא מובן דגם בבחינת תיקונין הנזכר לעיל על זה אמר גם כן איהו וגרמוהי חד
phrases.en: So even on the external *tikunim* it says even there, and even all the way down to the *kelim* in *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya*.

phrases.he: משום דגבול בפועל מתאחד עם הגבול בכח המגביל לגבול זה שבפועל על דרך דוגמא מכח המגביל שביד, שמיוחד ומקושר בגבול בפועל שבתנועה כנזכר לעיל

blocks.text: So *ihu v'garmohi chad* holds **even on the external *tikunim***, down to the *kelim* of *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya*: the limit in act is one with the power that limited it.

blocks.title: The baseball bat
blocks.text: Hit someone over the head with a baseball bat, and your *etzem* did it, limiting itself to that movement. That is why he's guilty: it was a movement, yes, but you did it.

phrases.he: (ומכל שכן בכלים דמוחא ולבא כו', שאינם נקרא גבול בפועל עדיין כנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: And those for sure are not called a *gvul b'poel*; it's just an ability, like the *moach*, like your brain.

phrases.he: רק שמגבילים ומתארים לאורות שיהיה ניכר במציאת יש בלבד
phrases.en: It only brings it to a *hagbala* of a *metzius yesh*: that the *moach* is now a *hiyuli* for *haskalos*.

blocks.text: All the more the *kelim* of *mocha* and *liba*, which **for sure are not called a *gvul b'poel***: just an ability, like your brain, not yet any particular thought; the eye and the hand likewise, a *koach hatnua*, not a movement.

**It only brings it to a *hagbala* of a *metzius yesh***: the *moach* a *hiyuli* (raw potential) for *haskalos* (ideas), the eye for sight, the heart for emotions; none there yet, but each already a *mida* (measure): intellect, *middos*, and in the liver the gut feelings.

phrases.he: אבל יש להן שרש בעצמות, כמו שיש לאורות שורש בעצמות בשקול
phrases.en: It's *mamash* they're equal.

phrases.he: וכח ומקור אחד ממש,
phrases.en: It's *mamash* one power and one *makor*.

phrases.he: שהוא בחינת אין סוף ממש
דכמו שאור אין סוף למטה עד כו', כך למעלה כו'
phrases.en: The same thing: the light can go up into total infinity. It can go down, down into total finiteness.

blocks.text: The *kelim* are rooted in the *Atzmus* like the lights: **it's *mamash* they're equal**. If anything, the *kelim* are higher: "A woman of valor is the crown of her husband": a *kli* is a *Keser* (crown) that holds it in.
**It's *mamash* one power and one *makor*** (source), the *Ein Sof* itself. **The light can go up into total infinity. It can go down, down into total finiteness.**

sections.title: Chesed and gevura of the Essence, turned over for the receiver
sections.summary: In the Essence the light is the *chesed* and the *tzimtzum* the *gevura*. From the receiver's side it turns over, as right and left do for two people facing each other: the *tzimtzum* is the kindness that lets us exist, and too much light is a *gevura*, as at Sancheriv's camp.

phrases.he: שהן חסד וגבורה שבעצמות
phrases.en: And that's *chesed* and *gevura* in the *Atzmus*.

phrases.he: ואמנם באורות וכלים בשרשן נהפוך הוא מבבחינת גילויין
phrases.en: But in the *shoresh* you're looking at it backwards.

blocks.text: **That's *chesed* and *gevura* in the *Atzmus***: the light is *chesed*, the *tzimtzum* *gevura*.

blocks.title: Two people facing each other
blocks.text: **But in the *shoresh* you're looking at it backwards**: when two people face each other, my right is your left. The *mekabel*'s (receiver's) right is the *mashpia*'s (giver's) left, so upstairs is the opposite of the revelation.

phrases.he: דבגלויין הרי בחינת צמצום באורות וחסדים בהתפשטות בכלים
phrases.en: The lights are the ones that get lessened.

blocks.text: In the revelation the **lights are the ones that get lessened**, and the spreading is *davka* the *tzimtzum*, the *chesed*: without it nothing could pass from *mashpia* to *mekabel*.

phrases.he: דגם שהן מגבילים, הרי על ידם כל התפשטות למטה דוקא
ובשרשם להיפוך דהצמצום ברשימו העושה הגבול בכח כו', והחסדים בהתפשטות הוא לאורות, שהוא מבחינת הקו כו' כמו שכתוב במקום אחר ודי למבין:
phrases.en: So upstairs, as far as the *Aibershter* Himself is concerned, the light is the *chesed*, and the *tzimtzum* is the *gevura*.

blocks.text: **Upstairs, as far as the *Aibershter* Himself is concerned, the light is the *chesed*, and the *tzimtzum* is the *gevura***. From our side the *tzimtzum* is *chesed*, without which we couldn't exist, and the light *gevura*.

blocks.title: Sancheriv's camp, and the sun
blocks.text: Sancheriv's camp was given more light than it could take, and it blew them up. If the sun got too strong: the *chesed* is that it is kept far away, and through a *masach* (screen).

reviewQuestions.question: Why must the vessel come before the light, and what do the balloon and the popsicle mold show about it?
What are the two differences between the power to limit and the limit in act?
What does "whoever wants to give $50 can give $100" teach about the limits that come from the *Aibershter*?
Why does the text mean *docheh* and not *domeh*, and in what sense are the two powers still equal?
How can the vessels of *Atzilus* be called a limit in act in one place and only a power to limit in another?
Why is the *tzimtzum* a *chesed* from our side, though above it is the *gevura*?

notes.text: Class 043 opens (w0-951) by finishing class 042's discussion of the inner and outer names of the cat and the kavanos (chapter 28, which ends with the same friend's name). Class 043 is catalogued only for chapter 29, so it is placed in four blocks with outOfPlace at the head of the first passage. The friend the class all knows is named in class ("Shmueli", 043 w381-416, w717, w3284-3306); per STYLE.md he is "a friend we all know" in the text. At w234-236 the transcript has "אין כבוד מלכותו", which is garbled; the king block leaves it out.

Line 27: the chapter file reads "בחינת כח המכווץ שדומה לכח המתפשט". He reads "כח המגביל שדוחה לכח המתפשט" (043 w2549-2554, w2619-2624) and says the printed "דומה" is a mistaken correction and the original reads "דוחה". The block reports this as he said it; I did not check an edition. Lines 26 and 27 are one passage because he reads line 27's words already at w2549.
Line 36 in the chapter file begins with a stray Latin letter: "(uוהוא שם העצם" (for the owner of data/chapters).

Lines 1, 3-8, 14, 17, 19-22, 24, 30, 31, 33-35, 39-40, 49-50 are read without an English rendering, so their phrases have no en. For line 2 the English is his summary of lines 2-4 ("the kli really comes before the light", w1032-1051); for line 12, "It's not a matter of an actual gvul" is said after he reads line 13's first words. Line 43's phrase runs to line 44's first word, "בשקול", which is what his "It's mamash they're equal" translates (he reads "בשוה", w3703).

"The Rebbe says" (043 w1500) is the author, the Mitteler Rebbe; "as it explains in certain places" (w1421) is not identified in class. "Like it said before, והנורא" (w2745-2759) refers to an earlier class's reading of "the great, the mighty and the awesome", where the awesome is tiferes; kept as he said it.

Line 47's alignment (044 w58, conf 0.6) catches a garbled reading ("אמנם בעת הכלים משרשן נהפכו"); line 48's "מבחינת גילויים" is read at w120. Class 044 is shared with chapter 30: only w0-407 is cited here.
